purpose: Document first-party Matsuyama cadastral custody, public map review, catalog discovery, and bounded anonymous safe-ID geometry verification.
assessment: Matsuyama City's official pages evidence local cadastral-survey custody and application/viewing procedures, and the public e~yo Machi Navi portal provides administrative map access. The G-Space CKAN catalog publishes a Ministry of Justice registry-map extract for Matsuyama; its anonymous GeoJSON was fetched and one safe-ID polygon intersected the exact WUP point. Runtime readiness remains held.
registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastral procedure is evidenced by Matsuyama City's official地籍調査 page, including city-held results and district-specific viewing/application information. This establishes institutional custody, not admission of an anonymous citywide parcel runtime source.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Matsuyama page dated 2025-07-04 describes cadastral survey, cadastral maps/books, city custody, district eligibility, application/viewing and fees; it includes owner/lot concepts in explanatory text, but none were retained.
Official Matsuyama public map portal says it publishes administrative information maps online; public HTML did not expose a cadastral parcel geometry endpoint.
Official FAQ links e~yo Machi Navi and describes anonymous map viewing for urban-planning information; not a cadastral geometry response.
Anonymous CKAN API response lists Matsuyama municipality code 38201 GeoJSON/SHP resources for 2022-2026 and the published download URLs.

Published GeoJSON fetched anonymously with TLS verification enabled; source FeatureCollection advertises CRS84 and safe ID field ID. The downloaded FeatureCollection name says 2025 despite the catalog URL/resource label saying 2026; this version-label uncertainty is recorded.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: A bounded 0.0000003-degree WGS84 window around exact unchanged WUP point [33.8263081285138, 132.766078613925] returned one intersecting source polygon (ID H000002385). This is not an absence/completeness test.

requestEvidence.response: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; CRS84; native ID ID; bounded spatial filter produced one exact-point intersecting polygon.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Catalog/resource and one bounded exact-point geometry verified; citywide completeness and full public coverage not verified.

remainingUncertainty: The city viewer's live JavaScript/configuration was not inspected for undocumented parcel layers; public registry-map coverage and 2025/2026 resource naming discrepancy remain unresolved. No unsafe record-specific fields were requested or retained.
